assessment_summary: In the algorithmic approach, line 0054 incorrectly calculates the size of the component containing $v_i$ after moving to $v_{i+1}$. The true size of this component (the union of all other components of $T-v_i$ plus $v_i$) is $n - |C|$, where $|C|$ is the size of the previous large component. However, the proof explicitly writes this size as $n - |C| - 1$, failing to properly account for the $+1$ from adding $v_i$. This off-by-one algebraic error makes the step mathematically flawed.
